text: @lovstudio/dsh-account-balance 是一款适用于 DSH 网页端的账户额度与运行状态卡片，会固定显示在界面右下角。它通过 shell.overlay 展示当前会话数和运行中的后台任务数，并查询 GLM、KIMI 的 5 小时及每周额度，以及 OpenRouter 和 DeepSeek 的余额。卡片定时刷新状态和额度，额度条可查看已用比例、剩余量与重置时间。适合希望在使用 DSH 时快速查看运行情况和模型账户用量的用户；对应服务额度查询需要在 DSH 凭据服务中配置各提供方密钥。

@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance is a DSH web overlay showing live session and running-job counts, GLM and KIMI quota windows, and OpenRouter and DeepSeek balances. It refreshes periodically and shows usage and reset details on hover. Provider credentials come from DSH’s credential service.
想在 DSH 页面角落同时看到当前会话数和正在运行的任务数。
有没有办法不用切换页面就查看 GLM、KIMI 的用量和余额？
I want a small web overlay that shows my active DSH sessions and running jobs.
@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance 的功能「状态与额度面板」：在 DSH 网页右下角定时显示会话、运行任务、GLM/KIMI 配额及 OpenRouter/DeepSeek 余额，悬停额度条可查看用量和重置时间。
@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance 使用前须知：配置相应提供方密钥后，Host 会携带 Bearer 凭据请求 GLM、KIMI、OpenRouter 和 DeepSeek 的额度接口，以获取账户用量与余额。

@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · @lovstudio/dsh-account-balance：The Host half exposes two Typert Remote faces — `accountBalance.status` and
`accountBalance.quotas`. `status` is a pure in-memory snapshot over
`ctx.agents.list()` and `ctx.jobs.list()`; it never scans session logs, so the
3-second browser poll stays sub-millisecond and cannot stall a user message.
`quotas` fans the four provider requests out in parallel and caches the result
for 55 seconds; every external number is normalized at the wire boundary and
rows are shaped strictly by mode, so the Remote JSON never carries an
`undefined` field. Provider credentials resolve per operation through
`ctx.credentials` (`ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY`, `KIMI_CODING_API_KEY`,
`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`) and never leave the Host.

@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · Install：Prerequisites: Node.js 22.19+ or 24+, pnpm 11 (`corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`) — `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory.

**From a DeepSeek Harness source checkout (recommended — you get the harness source too):**

```sh
git clone --depth 1 --branch dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness && pnpm install && pnpm run build
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:lovstudio/dsh-account-balance#v0.1.3
pnpm dsh web

@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · Install：**Without a checkout (npx; compiled harness only):**

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:lovstudio/dsh-account-balance#v0.1.3
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

`web` is the profile `dsh web` boots. The tag pins a commit whose `lib/` is prebuilt and committed, so nothing is compiled on your machine. Verified on 2026-09-04 against `dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1` in both forms. Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @lovstudio/dsh-account-balance`.

@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · `accountBalance.status(): Promise<RemoteResult<AccountBalanceStatusSnapshot>>`：Live process status: `{ sessions, tasks }` — distinct live session ids and
background jobs currently in the `running` state.

@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · Local development：Install dependencies and keep the Host and Client artifacts current from this
repository:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run watch
```

Mount the checkout into an isolated development profile rather than editing the
DeepSeek Harness workspace or the default `~/.dsh` profile:

```sh
DSH_HOME=/Users/mark/.dsh-lov-dev pnpm --dir /path/to/deepseek-harness dsh plugin --profile web add -w link:/path/to/dsh-account-balance
```

@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · Extension points：None — the card is a leaf surface. Consumers may read the same two Remote
faces for their own status/quota displays.

@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · What the model sees：Nothing. The card is browser-only UI; both Remote calls run outside model
turns and their results never enter a prompt.
@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · Token effect：Zero — the plugin performs no model calls.
@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · KV Cache effect：None — no prompt prefix is contributed.

@lovstudio/dsh-account-balance README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **`jobs.list()` visibility** — the Host status handler lists jobs without a
  caller, so jobs owned by another session may not be counted as `tasks`;
  unowned and visible jobs are counted.
- **Quota shape drift** — GLM and KIMI wire formats are extracted
  defensively; an API shape change surfaces as `no-data` rows rather than a
  crash.
- **Page reload / restart** — the plugin is a composition row, so it survives
  both once installed; before install it behaves like any other plugin package
  in this workspace.
